title: Has potential but incomplete
body: I think this app has great potential, but currently has a few significant shortcomings. 1. The editor overflows outside of the screen on iphone 14 pro. 2.There is no autoclose of brackets (, [ etc. 3. The text in the editor flows behind keyboard, which means you cannot access bottom part of your code while you type 4. It needs a toolbar above keyboard for shortcuts such as indent, undo, search, symbols like (, [ etc, as without them it’s really difficult to code without a physical keyboard. If those were fixed, I’d be very happy to pay for and use the app. I am looking forward to the dev’s updates and changing this review if the issues are addressed.
